title: ElevenLabs Text to Dialogue Eleven v3
description: Generate realistic audio dialogues using Eleven-v3 from ElevenLabs.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.default: [{"text": "[applause] Thank you all for coming tonight! Today we have a very special guest with us.", "voice": "Aria"}, {"text": "[gulps] ... [strong canadian accent] [excited] Hello everyone! Thank you all for having me tonight on this special day.", "voice": "Charlotte"}]
inputs.tooltip: A list of dialogue inputs, each containing text and a voice ID which will be converted into speech. JSON. Required.

inputs.name: stability
inputs.tooltip: Determines how stable the voice is and the randomness between each generation. Lower values introduce broader emotional range for the voice. Higher values can result in a monotonous voice with limited emotion. Must be one of 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, else it will be rounded to the nearest value. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: use_speaker_boost
inputs.tooltip: This setting boosts the similarity to the original speaker. Using this setting requires a slightly higher computational load, which in turn increases latency.

inputs.name: pronunciation_dictionary_locators
inputs.tooltip: A list of pronunciation dictionary locators (id, version_id) to be applied to the text. They will be applied in order. You may have up to 3 locators per request JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.tooltip: Random seed for reproducibility. -1 leaves it to the model.

inputs.name: language_code
inputs.tooltip: Language code (ISO 639-1) used to enforce a language for the model. An error will be returned if language code is not supported by the model. Empty leaves it out.
